plugins.name: cairn
plugins.description: Agent-first browser automation CLI. Navigate pages by stable ref, get compact hierarchical output, and see only what changed after each action (deltas). NL intents collapse perceive→ground→act→verify into one command. Use whenever the user needs to interact with websites, fill forms, click buttons, take screenshots, test web apps, or automate any browser task.
